adapt_array_reference_deltas.what: AddReferences in the command buffer and submission of its last pass references only the views and samplers counted since (bounded 1 024 per array; beyond, or a recount, the whole pass)
adapt_array_reference_deltas.why: Auto.Get adds one reference per command buffer; a referenced resource lives until its command buffer completes
